chat.request: Customer wants a stairlift: curved stair with one landing, rider is 280 lb, it’s for an outdoor porch at their home. — Pat
chat.question: One question: how long is the stair from the top step’s nose to the floor? Up to 10 ft keeps the price; I’ll list it to confirm on the visit.

standards: Rated load covers the 280 lb rider (350 lb unit)
